Delphos gown, blue-green pleated silk

c. 1920

Mariano Fortuny

Blue-green silk Delphos gown in "Peplos" style composed of finely pleated silk that falls in narrow, continuous folds from the shoulders to the floor. Inspired by the draped garments of ancient Greece, Fortuny developed his distinctive pleating process to create a lightweight, elastic textile that followed the body without conventional tailoring. Small glass beads weight the edges and seams, helping the pleats fall vertically while adding subtle movement and shimmer.
